settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.content:
When can I expect to notice changes?

Hair changes take time and consistency. With daily use, some women begin to notice reduced visible shedding within the first few weeks. Fuller-looking hair and overall improvements are typically noticed with continued use over the following months. Results vary from person to person, and consistency is key.

Will this affect my libido or hormones?

No. At the recommended dosage, there is no evidence suggesting changes to libido. Pumpkin Seed Oil is used to gently support hair health and does not dramatically alter hormone levels like certain prescription treatments.

Will this cause hair growth in unwanted areas?

No. Unlike topical treatments such as minoxidil, which may sometimes lead to unwanted facial hair growth, this formula is designed to support scalp hair without affecting body hair growth patterns.

How many should I take, and when?

Take 2 softgels daily with a meal. Consuming them with food helps support absorption. For best results, take them consistently as part of your daily routine.
